To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a test structure and extraction methodology are proposed to measure and model the S/D series resistivity in HKMG multifin bulk FinFETs.

the proposed test structure and the extraction method can be applied to evaluate the S/D series resistivity for each fin, which can be used to monitor the S/D process of the 16 nm HKMG bulk FinFET device.
the proposed test structure and technique provide a robust monitoring tool for the 16-nomultifin high-k/multigate (HK/MG) bulk FinFET device.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a new test structure and extraction techniques for S/D series resistance in 16-nm HKMG multifin bulk FinFETs, which can be used to evaluate the S/D resistance in different regions of a device and to identify the process weak points of S/D series resistors.
the extraction of S/D series resistivity and the modeling of S/D resistance in HKMG multifin bulk FinFETs.
the extraction of the S/D series resistivity in the HKMG bulk FinFETs with the 16-nM technology node.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed test structure can be used for effective extraction of S/D series resistivity in HKMG multifin bulk FinFET device, which can be used as a robust process monitoring tool for the 16-nM HKMG FinFET device.
the S/D series resistivity of 16-nm HKMG multifin FinFETs is dominated by the S/D contact resistance, which is the main process weak point in the S/D series extraction.
the proposed test structure and the extraction methodology provide a robust monitoring tool for the process weak point diagnosis of HKMG multifin bulk FinFET technology.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can extract each component of S-D series resistances, including contact, epi-growth, extension, and gate, respectively.
we can effectively extract the S/D series resistivity of each fin by swapping the S&D bias condition and the S/D contact resistance can also be extracted by the proposed test structure.
the S/D series resistivity for each fin is strongly related to the S/D e-pit depth.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we provide a robust monitoring tool for the S/D series resistivity extraction of the 16 nm multifin high-K/metal gate bulk finFET devices.
the proposed test structure and the extraction methodology are very useful for process monitoring and optimization.
the S/D series resistivity in the S/D extension is the main contributor of the S/D series series resistance, while the S/D series in the channel gate is the least important one.
